notes.title: Blasted Dice QoL Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey everyone! New patch today!

New icons, a few bug fixes and some item changes!



If you have any issues or find any bugs, feel free to leave a post on the Steam Community, send me an email or join the Discord. I check those pretty often!



Discord Link: https://discord.gg/jUZnFeAjse


New Icons!
There are now new icons for a free reroll, taking no damage or remaining at 1 health! They will always be under the player! You can also right click on them for a tooltip.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/5fcd8c72ba77dc2c72b2be985e6d7cd5f19d3beb.png"]
Item ChangesPassives
Tyche's Wheel

(1+?/4)x final score. ? Is the number of times you rerolled, this round. -> (1+?/8)x final score. ? Is the number of times you rerolled, this round.



Tyche's Rudder

+5 multiplier for each time you rerolled, this round. -> +4 multiplier for each time you rerolled, this round.



Tyche's Cornucopia

+5 score for each time you rerolled, this round. -> +4 score for each time you rerolled, this round.



Ares' Golden Spear

Enemies block for 0.

Price changed from 300 gold -> 200 gold.



Magnifying Glass

+100 gold whenever you open an Ate's Chest.

Was not working like the description says, now works correctly!



Jade

+25 gold on your first reroll each round.

Was not working with Lyre Harp (When pressing the reroll button, if you have no die selected, you reroll all dice.), now works correctly!



All 100 or more dice items/keepsakes now show the number of dice you currently have, in their tooltips.


Bug Fixes
Deployed some possible fixes for really specific bugs!





That's it! Good luck out there!

-Rodrigo

notes.title: Blasted Dice Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Just a few small fixes today!


Item Fixes
Blue Dice Pack and Red Dice Pack dice pools have been adjusted.

They now always give an equal or better value dice (compared to pack price).

(All other items that give dice also take advantage of this pool change!)



Asclepius Potion

If you would be defeated, remain at 1 health (once per use). -> If you would be defeated, remain at 1 health (once per use). Does not stack.

This item was not changed. It's just a small clarification.



Darkness Potion

You cannot take damage this turn. -> You cannot take damage from the enemy's next attack. Does not stack.

This item was not changed. It's just a small clarification.


Other Fixes
The Combat Speed setting now appears first on the Settings tab.



Tooltips on the End of Run screen are now translating correctly to other languages.



Fixed some translation errors/issues.



Fixed a bug where some item descriptions weren't appearing on an item's tooltip.





That's about it! Good luck out there!

-Rodrigo

notes.title: Enemies, Backgrounds, Tutorial and Completion
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Haven't made a devlog in a while, as I have been working on a lot of backend stuff. However, I have some things that might be good to show you. Especially, graphical stuff.

Also, the development of Blasted Dice has been going at a fairly good pace, which means, that if everything goes well, the release date should be somewhere at very start of June. I do still have a lot of things to finish, and more balance to do, but the start of June seems to be the right time to launch the game. I'll give more updates about the release date, in further devlogs!

On to the new stuff then!

All Final Enemies are Finished!
I've recently finished all enemies (except balance, that's still ongoing). Here's a few of the final enemies of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/bad2a21047e25cc2573f3656d04b184a53de334a.png

New and Reworked Backgrounds
I've also finished all remaining backgrounds, and did some small touch-ups on pre-existing ones.

Ruins (Renamed to Castle Outskirts)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/9f226208d235ed14c7f33662c0ab5b1e5b2255c9.png

Palace

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/8717e74f74a89e35e9a48494d0819ef139ff2690.png

Golden Fields

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/0449ec7de064e7a6756e9d4f082c44823c3e08f5.png

Forest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/e59debeded86c8ca3b109e445b34d41dbbe8bb69.png

New Revamped Tutorial
I've revamped the old tutorial. It is now much shorter and straight to the point (probably 10 times shorter now, by the way).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/931a87f6871dd36a54c32ee12824faa36e886f51.png

Completion
The backend for achievements is already done, it's just a matter of time until all achievements are added to the game, and also to Steam.
On regards to 100% completion, I've added a Star system to the game, which is also tied to the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/4982aee825af64b8f6c7b4577bb80e77c7f42c15.png


That's about it for this devlog! Most things are done or almost there! Next devlog should be at the start of next month (May). Probably about new items, story stuff or maybe something more about 100% completion!

Anyway, good luck out there!

notes.title: Starting Decks and QoL Changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you the second full release devlog!
These devlogs should come out once every week or so, up until the game releases.

Starting Decks
Every time you start a new run, you will be able to choose a deck to start with! Right now, there are 6 starting decks in the game you can choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/5b8434940ff4e3f4f7d43483bced06cbe958d054.png

They will be unlocked gradually as you complete runs. As it is right now, you'll get a new deck after playing a set number of runs (no wins needed!).
You will start with the original 12 normal dice deck when you first start playing the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/ee2995ce8024197a97db3a6c85d3b21679cc5ffb.png

Quality of Life Changes
You are now able to check dice, item and keepsake tooltips when doing actions such as attacking, blocking or rerolling! This was not possible before, but after seeing people playing the game, this felt like a needed change. Especially, if you are still learning what each item does.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/b97de1ea95265f3a3504306a43d2a3e7dbff40e9.png

And that's about it for this week! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out through our Discord, the Steam Community, or Email.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/jUZnFeAjse


I'll be back next week or so, for another devlog!
Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Introducing Keepsakes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a devlog about what I am working on for the full release.
These devlogs should come out once every week or so, up until the game releases.

Keepsakes
Keepsakes are permanent passives (you can't sell them after getting them). Their effects range from giving stats like multiplier or score, to changing how dice rerolls work, to giving you health, actives, dice, etc...
You will get a keepsake every 5 rounds by clicking The Shadows Chest and choosing between 3 options.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/5288f5fa029ecd6e308bb05f637740478939eff3.png
 
Max Dices Per Turn
Right now, in the demo, you get to play 3 dice at round 20, by choosing a passive from the chest. With the addition of keepsakes to the game, special keepsakes will instead give you the option to play more dices per turn.
This means that the previous passives that gave that option will be reworked into similar items, just without that option, and then, they will be put into the normal passives pool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/1a2a0febe32d317ea121109aadc44bf3d2b468cc.png

As of now, you get two specials keepsakes, per run, at rounds 10 and 20, meaning you get to play a max of 3 dice per turn starting at round 11, and 4 starting at round 21. This may change in the future, but from all the testing I've done, they seem to be the best spots to add another die to play,

Hidden Keepsakes
Some keepsakes will not be obtained through the normal chest way. Hidden Keepsakes can be obtained by doing all sorts of things, from gathering specific passives, actives, or doing other actions.
Once you complete the necessary hidden actions, they will appear on the keepsake's bar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/2e69675285c275f636e54aa6ec3709046c58e9eb.png

There were also some small QoL changes and bug fixes, but I'll talk about them in a future devlog.

And that's about it for this week! If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out through our Discord, the Steam Community, or Email.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/jUZnFeAjse


I'll be back next week or so, for another devlog!
Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo QoL/Balance Patch 1.0.4

Thanks so much for playing the demo and wishlisting the game! I'll be back soon with some content news, here and there, about the full release.

notes.title: Demo QoL/Balance Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a brand new patch, with some new quality of life options to make the game more streamlined. Also, there's a few balance changes.
Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

Combat Speed
Combat Speed can now be changed in the settings menu! There are 4 new speed levels(1,2,3 and 4), each one making the combat animations increasingly faster! Combat Speed level 1 is the original that has been in the game since the start. Combat Speed level 4 is the one in the gif below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/901169551db352afe8c62c62d7fefda8afb5d9d7.gif


Streamlined Shop Animations
Most shop animations, from buying dice to selling or buying items have been changed to be almost instant. This makes it so you don't have to wait to buy or sell items in bulk, leading to a more streamlined shop experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/4ed5372710c4ec819cf3a71febc8baed777cfd6a.gif


Enemy Changes

Swordsman(round 8, 18 and 28):

Changed moveset from attack/attack/reroll/reroll/heal to attack/reroll/attack/reroll/reroll/heal.

Item Changes

Passives
Singularity
If you play only 1 dice, +12 multiplier and +12 score.

Changed value from 10/10 to 12/12.

Dice Changes

Inverted Dice
Die face gives multiplier instead of score.

Changed cost from 200 to 100 gold.

Thank you so much to everyone that played the demo and/or added the game to their wishlist during the Steam Next Fest. Hope these changes make the demo better for you all!

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo Balance/Rework Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Today, I bring you a brand new patch, with lots of changes and a big rework to 'The Shadows'!
Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

The Shadows Rework
'The Shadows' have been reworked to now being a choice between adding initial score and initial multiplier(initial meaning before all other calculations).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226156/7b0b39c0373f658c7fc54138acad8d6e213a5f51.png
This change was made due to the earlier version being much more luck dependent, leading to times where you would entirely skip it, or you would end up too focused on a build with no chance to pivot to another.
That being said, to accomodate this rework, a lot of changes to enemies, items and other aspects had to be made, which can be found below.

Enemy Changes

Yellow Fighter(round 26):

Changed block value from 5400 to 4800.
Changed damage value from 4200/4800/5400 to 4200/4500/4800.

Yellow Shielded Fighter(round 27):

Changed block value from 6000 to 5100.
Changed damage value from 6000 to 5100.

Yellow Swordsman(round 28):

Changed damage value from 5400/6600 to 5100/5400.

Yellow Hoplite(round 29):

Changed block value from 9000 to 7200.
Changed damage value from 6600/7200 to 5400/6000.

The Gambler(round 30):

Changed moveset from reroll/attack to reroll/attack/reroll.

Crimson Snake(round 31):

Changed block value from 12000 to 10200.
Changed damage value from 9000 to 7500.
Changed healing percentage from 10% to 1% of max health.

Item Changes

Passives
Four-Leaf Clover
You get a random active whenever you buy a passive.

Changed cost from 100 to 50 gold.

Change of Ways
+10 healing dice multiplier.

Changed cost from 400 to 300 gold.

Shark Tooth
+?/100 multiplier on attacks. ? is the last block score, this round.

Changed cost from 400 to 350 gold.
Changed divider value from 125 to 100.

Buckler
On the first time you would be defeated, remain at 1 hp, once per round.

Changed cost from 100 to 75 gold.

Lyre Harp
When pressing the reroll button, if you have no dice selected, you reroll all dice.

Changed cost from 100 to 50 gold.

Coin of a True Soldier
All items in the shop are 30% cheaper.

Changed cost from 300 to 250 gold.

Pomegranate
Heal dice heal 3x more when played.

Changed cost from 100 to 50 gold.

Toasty
If you only have normal dice in your deck, 2x final score.

Changed cost from 400 to 300 gold.
Changed value from 1.5 to 2.

Red Amphora
x3 initial multiplier.

Changed value from 4 to 3.

Lost Ways
x1.5 multiplier on up and down dice.

Changed value from 1.6 to 1.5.

The Last Stone
+16 score on blocks.

Changed value from 12 to 16.

Zeus' Sceptre
+1 max dice per turn (max: 4). +115 final score per enemy defeated.

Changed value from 100 to 115.

Artemis' Quiver
+0.6 score for each die in the deck.

Changed value from 0.3 to 0.6.

Red Herring
+3 normal dice multiplier.

Changed value from 2 to 3.

Short Sword
+6 die face score to each die with a face not equal to 1.

Changed value from 4 to 6.

Crimson Sword
+6 die face score to each die with a face equal to 1.

Changed value from 4 to 6.

Alpha
x4 multiplier on 'None' combos.

Changed value from 2 to 4.

Crimson Alpha
x4 multiplier on 'Ace' combos.

Changed value from 2 to 4.

Cerulean Alpha
+24 score on 'None' combos.

Changed value from 12 to 24.

Amethyst Alpha
+30 score on 'Ace' combos.

Changed value from 12 to 30.


Actives
Asclepius' Potion
If you would be defeated, remain at 1 hp (once per use).

Changed cost from 100 to 75 gold.

Dice Changes

Critical Dice

Changed cost from 300 to 200 gold.

Other Changes

Changed starting deck size from 16 to 12 dice.
Changed dice face outcome logic on most dice.

Bug Fixes

Fixed Artemis' Quiver and Apollo's Bow and Arrow not updating their score and multiplier values on dice deck changes.
Fixed tooltip showing the wrong sell price for actives.

Thank you so much for playing the demo! Remember to add the game to your wishlist, if you haven't yet!

Steam Next Fest starts in less than 48 hours, so a balance patch should be released some time next week, after I get some more feedback.

Thank you for reading! Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo

notes.title: Demo Balance Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
Today, I'm releasing a new balance patch to address round progression problems and some other issues. Keep in mind, runs will be reset, because of the new patch.
This is all possible thanks to your feedback, so if you have any (or found some other issue), feel free to reach out via the Steam Community, our Discord, or Email.

Enemy Changes:

Changed Hoplite's(round 9, 19 and 29) moveset (he now heals less often).
Changed Hoplite's(round 9, 19 and 29) heal percentage from 20%->15% of max health.
Changed Blue Hoplite's(round 19) damage from 800/850->700/800.
Removed healing from Shielded Fighter's(round 7, 17 and 27) moveset.
Changed Red Shielded Fighter's(round 7) block value from 60->35.

Item Changes:
Actives:

Throwing Axe - Deals 50 damage to an enemy. -> Deals '35 x round number' damage to an enemy.
Red Marble - +3 multiplier on next action. -> +6 multiplier on next action.
Potion of Fortitude - +3 multiplier on next block. -> +4 multiplier on next block.
Potion of Rage - +3 multiplier on next attack. -> +4 multiplier on next attack.

Passives:

Telegonus' Spear - +5 multiplier for each attack die played. -> +6 multiplier for each attack die played.
Anchor - +5 multiplier for each block die played. -> +6 multiplier for each block die played.

Shop Changes:

Changed dice removal cost from 60->50 gold.

Bug/Other Fixes:

Fixed a bug where dice would remain selected after going back to main menu, and then returning back to combat.
Fixed some grammar errors.

Thanks so much for playing the demo and giving great feedback! I expect to release another patch later this week, as we get closer and closer to Steam Next Fest.

Good luck out there!
-Rodrigo
